title: Hayom Yom daily-entry body review — nine Hebrew/Yiddish original-language excerpts
review_method: Manual public web search/open. AID 4666220 was opened but redirected to a rewritten Torah Texts summary shell with no item-level body. As a fallback, nine distinct Hayom Yom item pages were opened and their visible Hebrew/Yiddish source excerpts were inspected alongside the same-page English translations. Only the daily entry text was paraphrased; editorial explanations were not treated as source propositions.
source_body_inspection_method: Public web search/open. Nine item-level Hayom Yom pages were opened and the visible original Hebrew/Yiddish passages were read; the same-page English translations were used only as a cross-check, not as independent witnesses.

fallback_source_results.source: Chabad.org / TheRebbe.org — Hayom Yom daily entries
fallback_source_results.result: Nine item-level pages with visible original Hebrew/Yiddish passages and corresponding English translations were inspected; each entry was assigned a separate Evidence Family; no separate translation witness was created.

blocked_candidates.reason: The public page redirected to https://www.chabad.org/torah-texts/4666220/page/default.htm, a rewritten summary/navigation shell with no inspectable item-level letter body.
blocked_candidates.handling: Excluded from content propositions; no crawler retry or access-control bypass. Nine accessible Hayom Yom item bodies were inspected as the same-run fallback.

deduplication_check.note: Exact-AID repository searches returned no matches for the nine AIDs, and recent content batches 070–090 were checked. The full 461-file canonical item corpus was not exhaustively scanned through the connector; reconciliation must deduplicate by stable AID and URL before metrics are accepted.

limitations: All nine records remain Parsed; no source was promoted to Verified.
The original printed Hayom Yom edition, manuscript or authorial proofs were not inspected.
The English translations are on the same publisher pages and are not independent witnesses.
Embedded teachings or quotations attributed in the entry to the Alter Rebbe, Tzemach Tzedek or Rebbe Rayatz remain attributed to those figures; they are not reattributed to the Rebbe.
The source pages are daily anthology entries, not personal correspondence and not individualized answers.
No full copyrighted text was copied; only bounded Hebrew research paraphrases and exact source locators were stored.

records.title: Hayom Yom — 18 Tammuz
records.date_original: 18 Tammuz (recurring calendar entry; year not specified on the item page)
